prerequisites: Knowledge of Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering and Specific Mechanical Technology

learning_outcomes.text: Will design and calculate metal structures.

syllabus_topics: Technology of steel. Typologies, actions, load hypotheses and limit states of steel structures. Design of steel elements, bolted joints, welded joints and fire resistance.
CHAPTER I. INTRODUCTION TO THE DESIGN OF STEEL STRUCTURES
TOPIC 1.- INTRODUCTION TO THE DESIGN OF STEEL STRUCTURES.
TOPIC 4.- SAFETY, PROJECT SITUATIONS AND CALCULATION BASES.
TOPIC 5.- CALCULATION HYPOTHESES ACCORDING TO LIMIT STATES
CHAPTER III. STRUCTURAL ANALYSIS IN STEEL STRUCTURES
CHAPTER V. CALCULATION OF STRUCTURES AND THEIR ELEMENTS
CHAPTER VII. ADDITIONAL ASPECTS TO THE ANALYSIS
TOPIC 14.- BOLTED AND WELDED JOINTS, MIXED AND VARIOUS
TOPIC 17.- ASPECTS ON: MANUFACTURING. EXECUTION, CONTROL, MAINTENANCE AND SUSTAINABILITY.
PRACTICES: COMPUTER CALCULATION OF INDUSTRIAL BUILDINGS AND VARIOUS STEEL ELEMENTS.
assessment_rules: For part-time students (recognized by the UR), non-recoverable assessment activities will be replaced by equivalent ones, provided the reason for their non-completion is the same for which the University granted them part-time student status. There are no critical criteria for passing the course.
